subject.title: Feature: Add costCurrency config option to customize cost display currency

question: Should OpenClaw add non-USD currency semantics for configured model costs, and if so should the currency live per model, per provider, globally, or only as a display preference?
rationale: The request adds a new config surface and changes how cost values are interpreted across display, session state, usage aggregation, docs, and USD telemetry.

options.title: Define the currency contract first
options.body: Choose scope and accounting/display semantics before implementation so all cost surfaces stay consistent.

options.title: Keep costs USD-only
options.body: Leave configured model costs as USD-only and treat non-USD local provider pricing as unsupported for now.

options.title: Add display-only symbol
options.body: Add a narrow display preference while explicitly keeping stored values and telemetry as USD-like estimates.

recommendation.title: Define the currency contract first
recommendation.body: Choose scope and accounting/display semantics before implementation so all cost surfaces stay consistent.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter introduced the usage cost reporting path and is the best available routing candidate for the product/config contract.
